incidents.name: BGLD deflationary transfer and migration
incidents.notes: The old BGLD token's deflationary transfer burns from the liquidity pair's own balance without sync(), so the attacker skimmed the imbalance out of the WBNB pair and then ran the surplus through the migration proxy into newBGLD.

sources.ref: onchain review: oldBGLD 0xC2319E87280c64e2557a51Cb324713Dd8d1410a3 created 2021-11-03T20:15:11Z by 0xae85a0d7406e83436a9d0753c8f9fe1fcbb6fcd8, unrelated to attack sender 0xf4fd2ebe7196c8e99e88bcc4aef69dda0e493b8f; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events, age measured from deployment. Loss verified onchain: the attacker netted 8.7957 WBNB and 18,476.30 USDT; 8.7957 WBNB x $276.76 at incidentTimestamp 1670859425 (DefiLlama coingecko:binancecoin) = $2,434, giving $20,911 in total.
